description: This file defines interfaces related to stream namespace predicates used for filtering implicit subscriptions in Orleans Streams. It includes the IStreamNamespacePredicate interface for matching stream namespaces and the IStreamNamespacePredicateProvider interface for creating predicate instances from pattern strings.

classes.name: IStreamNamespacePredicate
classes.description: Interface for predicates that determine if a stream namespace matches certain criteria, used for filtering implicit subscriptions.

classes.name: IStreamNamespacePredicateProvider
classes.description: Interface for providers that create IStreamNamespacePredicate instances from pattern strings.

methods.name: IsMatch
methods.description: Determines if the specified stream namespace matches the predicate criteria.

methods.name: PredicatePattern
methods.description: Property that provides a pattern string describing the predicate.

methods.name: TryGetPredicate
methods.description: Attempts to create a predicate from a pattern string; returns false if unable.
